channel.title: Daily Thanthi Group - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Daily Thanthi Group (dtnext.in)

item.title: Putin calls talks with US on ending the Ukraine war 'useful' but also 'difficult work'
item.description: The high-stakes talks are part of Trump's renewed push to end the nearly four-year war. The peace effort has recently gathered steam, even though reconciling Russia's and Ukraine's “red lines” still appears to be an uphill battle.

item.title: Gold falls Rs 600 to Rs 1,31,600/10g on muted global trends, rate-cut jitters
item.description: "Gold prices retreated on Thursday amid a lack of follow-up buying and a cautious tone among market participants ahead of next week's Federal Open Market Committee policy decision," Saumil Gandhi, Senior Analyst - Commodities at HDFC Securities, said.

item.title: I will remain PMK chief till Aug 2026 as per Delhi HC verdict, says Anbumani Ramadoss
item.description: Speaking to reporters after the Delhi High Court issued its verdict on Thursday, Anbumani said a faction in the party, rallying behind his father and PMK founder Dr S Ramadoss, tried many times to remove him as the president of the Pattali Makkal Katchi (PMK).

item.title: Rajya Sabha members seek ban on 'misleading' advertisements on tobacco products
item.description: AIADMK's M Thambidurai extended his support to the bill, provided the shares of the state governments get their due share.

item.title: We wanted to tell a story that feels lived, not performed, says director Vipin Radhakrishnan
item.description: Vipin also goes on to give credit to other members of his film's cast for their fine performances.

item.title: Russian president Putin arrives in Delhi on 2-day visit
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will host a private dinner for Putin this evening to set the tone for the 23rd India-Russia summit talks on Friday.

item.title: Pakistan allows UN to send relief supplies to Afghanistan through 2 key border crossings
item.description: All border crossings were shut in early October after Afghan forces attacked Pakistani military posts in retaliation for Pakistani strikes deep inside Afghanistan.

item.title: Chennai Corporation cancels global tender for SWM in Anna Nagar, Tondiarpet zones; new bid to be issued
item.description: The decision on cancellation was made to raise service standards and broaden the scope of work to meet increasing public demands, a statement from the civic body read.

item.title: Pak court petitioned to allow Imran Khan's medical examination by specialist from hospital he set up
item.description: Khan, the 73-year-old former cricketer-turned-politician, has been lodged at the Adiala Jail in Punjab province in connection with multiple cases since 2023 after he was first arrested in August that year.

item.title: 10 VB trains, 4 Shatabdis among 16 trains under Tatkal OTP booking
item.description: A Southern Railway (SR) circular from the senior commercial manager of the passenger reservation system, dated December 3, notified of the changes in Tatkal booking across all six divisions.
